name: Wadgaon Sheri
civicNote: Administered by PMC; ward office on Nagar Road.
summary: A residential and commercial neighbourhood in east Pune between Nagar Road and the Mula-Mutha river. It was formerly a village outside the city.
knownFor: Christ College and De Nobili College
Offices and warehouses of several IT and e-commerce firms
connectivity: Bounded by Nagar Road to the north; Pune Metro Line 2 (Aqua) Ramwadi terminus is nearby
About 5 km from Pune airport and about 6.5 km from Pune Junction
suits: Families and professionals who want to be near the Kharadi and Viman Nagar office hubs and the airport.
